title: Conscious micro-epochs: seen, unseen, seen, unseen
summary: A macaque's face cells flip about 15 times a second between the face that is seen and the one that is suppressed. Thirteen figures walk through the puzzle, the method, the controls and what it means.

source.label: Hesse, Lanfranchi, McGrory, Shi, Engel & Tsao · bioRxiv, October 2026 (preprint)
